scripts.prebuild: npm pkg set dependencies.next=15.5.24 devDependencies.eslint-config-next=15.5.24 devDependencies.@opennextjs/cloudflare=1.20.6 devDependencies.wrangler=4.130.0 && npm install --force
scripts.d1:migrate:preview: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply sectionxscoreboard-preview --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.d1:verify:preview: npx wrangler d1 execute sectionxscoreboard-preview --remote --config wrangler.jsonc --command="SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name;"
scripts.cloudflare:build: npm run prebuild && npm run d1:migrate:preview && npm run d1:verify:preview && npx @opennextjs/cloudflare build
